# Psalm 145 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-praise of-David. I-will-exalt-you my-God the-King, and-I-will-bless your-name to-forever and-ever.

**2** Every day I-will-bless-you, and-I-will-praise your-name to-forever and-ever.

**3** Great YHWH and-praised greatly, and-to-his-greatness there-is-no searching.

**4** Generation to-generation will-praise your-works, and-your-mighty-deeds they-will-declare.

**5** The-splendor-of glory-of your-majesty, and-words-of your-wonders I-will-meditate.

**6** And-power-of your-fearsome-deeds they-will-speak, and-your-greatness I-will-recount.

**7** The-memory-of your-great goodness they-will-pour-forth, and-your-righteousness they-will-sing-for-joy.

**8** Gracious and-compassionate YHWH, slow-of anger and-great-in-steadfast-love.

**9** Good YHWH to-all, and-his-compassion over-all his-works.

**10** Will-give-thanks-to-you O-YHWH all your-works, and-your-faithful-ones will-bless-you.

**11** The-glory-of your-kingdom they-will-speak, and-your-might they-will-tell,

**12** To-make-known to-sons-of man his-mighty-deeds, and-glory-of majesty-of his-kingdom.

**13** Your-kingdom a-kingdom-of all ages, and-your-dominion in-all generation and-generation.

**14** Upholds YHWH all the-falling, and-raises-up all the-bowed-down.

**15** The-eyes-of all to-you look, and-you give to-them their-food in-its-time.

**16** Opening your-hand, and-satisfying to-every living-thing desire.

**17** Righteous YHWH in-all his-ways, and-faithful in-all his-works.

**18** Near YHWH to-all calling-on-him, to-all who call-on-him in-truth.

**19** The-desire-of those-fearing-him he-will-do, and-their-cry he-will-hear, and-he-will-save-them.

**20** Keeps YHWH all loving-him, and-all the-wicked he-will-destroy.

**21** The-praise-of YHWH will-speak my-mouth, and-will-bless all flesh name-of his-holiness to-forever and-ever.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **145:1-21**: The last Davidic psalm and the only psalm titled tehillah ('praise'). An acrostic (aleph-tav, minus nun in MT — supplied in DSS and LXX).

- **145:8-9**: Exodus 34:6 quoted again — 'gracious and-compassionate... slow-of-anger' — with the universalizing addition: 'Good to-all... his-compassion over-all his-works.'

- **145:16**: 'Opening your-hand, and-satisfying to-every living-thing desire' — divine generosity extending to all creation, not just Israel.

— EMET
